_readme: Story text for Nothing Becomes Everything. tools/build_place.py merges this with upload/audio_manifest.json into src/ReplicatedStorage/Content.lua. Captions come from the manifest; everything here is either Brandon's own words or plain UI copy.

insightOverrides.time: Even while you are watching this, it is already taking the next second.
